description: Managed here: GitHub Actions, both pinned ruff versions (validate.yml and requirements_test.txt), and the test harness.

Deliberately not managed: caldav, icalendar and vobject. Home Assistant installs them into the same environment as the built-in caldav integration, so they must match the versions core pins, not the latest release on PyPI. They live in manifest.json and are mirrored in requirements_test.txt; the rule below leaves them alone in both.

Automerged: everything a pull request run actually exercises. Renovate merges only once the branch is green, so a failing run leaves the PR open. Nothing is proposed before the release is three days old.

packageRules.description: The release workflow runs on a tag only, so no pull request check covers this action.
Mirrors the manifest.json pins, which follow Home Assistant core.
One PR for both ruff pins, so CI and the local venv cannot drift apart. Last, because a later rule wins per field and the catch-all above matches ruff in requirements_test.txt too.
